Summary: Lightning McQueen is a hot-shot young race car competing for the coveted Piston Cup. But when he gets lost on the way to a big race, he realizes that he still has a lot to learn about what it takes to be a true friend. This exciting retelling of the newest Disney/Pixar film is sure to be a hit with young speedsters!
Customer Reviews (Text): Customers find this book great for children, particularly as a gift for 2-year-olds, and appreciate its cute illustrations with an adorable vintage feel. The story quality receives positive feedback, with one customer noting it captures the original storyline well, and customers find it engaging and worth the price. The book's length receives mixed reviews, with some finding it appropriate while others note it's shorter than expected. Customers like the vivid colors and content, with one mentioning it's a must-have for Cars fans.
